items.prompt: Capacity 2 currently has LRU order [A,B]. GET Z misses. Which order remains?

options.why: A miss emits MISS without creating or refreshing any cache entry.
Only a successful GET of A would move A to MRU.
A miss does not insert Z or evict A.
The miss does not add a new key, and this also exceeds capacity.
